* '''PC-E1''' ([[How Liberty Dies (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on Galactic Senate. Your Political Effects are canceled. Twice per turn, may target your agenda here: Justice: During battle, subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny. Order: During any move phase, peek at the top 2 cards of any Reserve Deck and replace in any order. Peace: Subtract 1 from attrition against you. Taxation: Place a card with no printed destiny number &gt; 4 from hand in Used Pile to activate 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[How Liberty Dies]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[How Liberty Dies]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•How Liberty Dies”; the printed face matches the image in visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[How Liberty Dies (Errata 2)]]): PC card image in the repository revision of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-hld-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/howlibertydies.gif howlibertydies.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”.
